purpose: Expected behaviors for human/host evaluation, not automatically measured semantic quality.

cases.query: Should we reconsider the managed queue?

memories.title: choice
memories.summary: We rejected the managed queue because only one engineer could operate integrations.

memories.title: staff
memories.summary: Three engineers are now trained on queue operations.

cases.expected_behavior: Treat the old staffing premise as changed; reconsider feasibility without claiming the managed queue is automatically best.

cases.query: Can we depend on the six-hour backup?

memories.title: audit
memories.summary: The latest operator report says backup scheduling is disabled.

cases.expected_behavior: Expose the unresolved conflict and ask for/check current operational evidence before asserting a backup interval.

cases.query: How should I plan this prototype?
cases.current_context: For this prototype I want rapid experiments and accept replacing code later.

memories.title: preference
memories.summary: The user previously preferred stable architecture and minimal rewrites.

cases.expected_behavior: Honor current explicit experiment preference; do not freeze the user in the old preference.

cases.query: Does the migration reliably reduce cost?

memories.title: cost
memories.summary: An agent summarized one trial as possibly 10% cheaper.

memories.title: cost_copy
memories.summary: Copy of the same trial: possibly 10% cheaper.

cases.expected_behavior: Treat the two records as one uncertain origin, not independent corroboration or proof of reliable savings.

cases.query: What queue did we decide to adopt?

memories.title: proposal
memories.summary: The assistant proposed switching to Kafka; the user has not accepted.

cases.expected_behavior: Say the memory is a proposal and no accepted choice is evidenced; never report Kafka as a settled decision.

cases.query: Should we repeat the indexing approach?

memories.title: index
memories.summary: We chose an index expecting faster lookups. No measurements after deployment have been recorded.

cases.expected_behavior: Distinguish expected benefit from observed result and propose checking latency measurements before repeating the approach.

memories.title: queue
memories.summary: We chose Redis to reduce maintenance.

cases.expected_behavior: Answer 4 directly; do not force unrelated personal/project insight.
